document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You  scream  maniacally  and  rush  for  the  deep  woods.  As  a 
crazed, berserk creature, you roam the valley alone for days—
or  perhaps  for  weeks  or  years.  Feeding  on  carrion,  digging 
roots with your fingernails, your physical aspect would horrify 
anyone who saw you.

The  sight  of  any  large  animal  brings  back  hideous  fears. 
One day such a flight causes you to run over the edge of a 
canyon, into the rapids below. Your wretched existence ends 
in drowning.
The Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
